body.body:
## 中文版

### 基准测试数据集

- 多轮对话评测：新增 MT-Bench，支持两轮对话和可配置的 Judge，遵循官方评分流程。
- Agent 评测：新增 Terminal-Bench 4.0（`terminal_bench_v4`），固定官方数据版本 `4.0.0`，支持任务筛选、重复试验及独立验证环境。
- 决策能力评测：新增 ANLI、BoolQ、BANKING77、ContractNLI、RewardBench v1，默认从 ModelScope 加载，支持普通 LLM 和 System One Choice 评测。

### 功能增强

- System One Choice：新增 `eval_type='systemone_api'`，通过现有模型接口支持文本单选决策模型，并保留选项概率、置信度和请求信息。
- 数学评分：统一使用固定版本 Math-Verify 进行答案提取、解析与等价判断，覆盖 29 个基准，保留各基准的容差、部分得分及多答案规则。
- 基准加载：适配器改为按需加载，减少 CLI 和库导入时加载整个基准目录的开销。
- 数据集缓存：Native 加载支持复用 ModelScope SDK 本地快照；优化临时 Arrow 缓存、并发写入和中断恢复。
- 多模态性能测试：新增真实 MMMU 多图数据模式，保留提示中的图像占位顺序。
- 多轮性能测试：支持会话 ID 与逐轮请求 ID，SWE-Smith 数据构建支持副本生成，并减少延迟指标收集开销。
- SLA 自动调优：支持显式 `s` / `ms` 阈值单位，校验指标有效性，使用准确请求计数，并改进约束与优化搜索。
- Dashboard：展示已安装的 EvalScope 版本，并提供本地化说明。

### 文档优化

- 更新 System One、Terminal-Bench 4.0、SLA 调优、多轮性能测试和数据缓存使用指南。
- 新增 DeepSearchQA 的 Parallel Search MCP 示例与 Qwen-Image 文生图评测示例。
- 修复性能结果分析、函数调用 API key、Python 3.10 示例以及多处外部文档链接。

### 问题修复

- 修复 AI2D 图像版本按图而非逐题选择的问题，依据官方 `abcLabel` 标注选择原图或字母标注图。
- 修复 IFBench 关键词/姓名子串匹配、部分校验器与上游不一致及无单词回复的除零问题。
- 修复 AlpacaEval 胜负被计为 0.75/0.25、HallusionBench 分组、OCRBench-v2 类别宏平均、PubMedQA 未识别答案分母及 collection 宏平均问题。
- 修复 BFCL-v3、ACEBench 和 OCRBench-v2 汇总行重复计入总分/样本数，以及 vote@k 将空答案纳入投票的问题。
- 修复 C-Eval 答案格式解析、中文多选分隔符、MMLU-Redux 多答案标注和 BBH 自由答案括号保留问题。
- 修复 NER 重复实体与 BIO 边界、LiveCodeBench sandbox 输出比较和视频压缩包文件匹配问题。
- 修复流式性能测试中的工具调用 TTFT、推理文本 token 估算、Responses ITL/失败识别/缓存用量、单 token TPOT、分位数精度与 NaN、推测解码估算及 embedding/rerank 响应体延迟统计。
- 修复 Anthropic 图片 URL 和 thinking/signature 历史保留、Responses 中断重试及自定义 finish reason 处理。
- 修复 Agent 提交数值 0、临时 HOME 清理、工具 Schema 字面量、缺省样本 metadata、本地音视频路径，以及未测量 PD 指标导致性能详情 API 返回 500 等问题。
- 修复 Terminal-Bench 的 Codex `max_turns` 兼容问题，并更新 Full CI 的文本/视觉模型配置。

### 升级说明

- 数学评分涉及的 29 个基准、22 个 NER 基准及 AI2D、IFBench 等评分修复均更新了相应评测版本。比较结果时请核对 `evaluation_version`；旧预测可通过 `rerun_review=True` / `--rerun-review` 重新评分，旧 reviews 不能直接跨评测版本复用。
- AI2D `v1.1` 使用修正后的逐题图像，结果与 `v1.0` 不直接可比。Terminal-Bench 4.0 结果也不直接与 2.0/2.1 比较。
- Math-Verify 使用 ANTLR 4.13.2；当前 `ms-vlmeval==0.0.20` 要求 ANTLR 4.11.1，因此 `vlmeval` / `all` extras 的联合依赖安装存在冲突，请使用独立环境。数学解析与验证不提供硬超时。
- System One 仅支持文本单选；RewardBench v1 的整体 accuracy 按样本加权，ContractNLI 当前评估文档分类 accuracy，请勿将它们视为完整复现官方排行榜的全部指标。

---

## English Version

### Benchmark Datasets

- Multi-turn Evaluation: Added MT-Bench with two-turn conversations, configurable judges, and the official judging flow.
- Agent Evaluation: Added Terminal-Bench 4.0 (`terminal_bench_v4`), pinned to official revision `4.0.0`, with task filtering, repeated trials, and separate verifier environments.
- Decision Evaluation: Added ANLI, BoolQ, BANKING77, ContractNLI, and RewardBench v1, defaulting to ModelScope and supporting both standard LLM and System One Choice evaluation.

### Feature Enhancements

- System One Choice: Added `eval_type='systemone_api'` for text single-choice decision models through the existing model interface, retaining option probabilities, confidence, and request metadata.
- Mathematical Scoring: Unified extraction, parsing, and equivalence checking with pinned Math-Verify across 29 benchmarks, preserving benchmark-specific tolerances, partial credit, and multiple-answer policies.
- Benchmark Loading: Load adapters on demand to reduce full-catalog import overhead for CLI and library use.
- Dataset Caching: Reuse local ModelScope SDK snapshots in Native loading and improve temporary Arrow storage, concurrent cache publication, and interruption recovery.
- Multimodal Performance Testing: Added a real MMMU multi-image mode with correct prompt/image placeholder ordering.
- Multi-turn Performance Testing: Added conversation and per-turn request IDs, SWE-Smith dataset replication, and lower latency-metric collection overhead.
- SLA Auto-tuning: Added explicit `s` / `ms` threshold units, metric-validity checks, exact request-count handling, and improved constraint/optimization searches.
- Dashboard: Display the installed EvalScope version with localized guidance.

### Documentation

- Updated System One, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SLA auto-tuning, multi-turn performance testing, and dataset-cache guides.
- Added Parallel Search MCP for DeepSearchQA and a Qwen-Image text-to-image evaluation example.
- Fixed performance-result analysis, function-call API-key configuration, Python 3.10 examples, and external documentation links.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed AI2D image selection to follow each question's official `abcLabel` annotation instead of choosing one image variant per diagram.
- Fixed IFBench keyword/name substring matching, verifier deviations from upstream, and division by zero for word-less responses.
- Fixed AlpacaEval win/loss scores of 0.75/0.25, HallusionBench grouping, OCRBench-v2 category averaging, PubMedQA denominators for unrecognized answers, and collection macro averaging.
- Fixed summary-row double counting in BFCL-v3, ACEBench, and OCRBench-v2, and empty answers participating in vote@k.
- Fixed C-Eval answer parsing, Chinese multi-select separators, MMLU-Redux multi-answer annotations, and bracket preservation in BBH free-form targets.
- Fixed repeated NER entities and BIO boundaries, LiveCodeBench sandbox stdout comparison, and exact video archive-member matching.
- Fixed streamed tool-call TTFT, reasoning-token estimates, Responses ITL/failure/cached-usage handling, one-token TPOT, percentile precision/NaN handling, speculative-decoding estimates, and embedding/rerank response-body latency.
- Fixed Anthropic image URL and thinking/signature preservation, interrupted Responses retries, and provider-specific finish reasons.
- Fixed Agent numeric-zero submissions, temporary HOME cleanup, literal tool-schema values, missing sample metadata, local audio/video paths, and performance-detail API errors for unmeasured PD metrics.
- Fixed Codex `max_turns` compatibility in Terminal-Bench and updated Full CI's text/vision model configuration.

### Upgrade Notes

- Evaluation versions have changed for the 29 mathematical benchmarks, 22 NER benchmarks, and scoring fixes such as AI2D and IFBench. Check `evaluation_version` when comparing results. Use `rerun_review=True` / `--rerun-review` to rescore saved predictions; old reviews cannot be reused across evaluation versions.
- AI2D `v1.1` uses corrected per-question images and is not directly comparable with `v1.0`. Terminal-Bench 4.0 results are also not directly comparable with 2.0/2.1.
- Math-Verify uses ANTLR 4.13.2, while `ms-vlmeval==0.0.20` requires 4.11.1. Joint dependency installation with the `vlmeval` / `all` extras conflicts; use separate environments. Mathematical parsing and verification have no hard timeout.
- System One supports text single-choice tasks only. RewardBench v1 reports sample-weighted overall accuracy, and ContractNLI currently evaluates document-classification accuracy; these are not full reproductions of every official leaderboard metric.

MLflow 3.17.0 includes several major features and improvements.

### Major New Features

- **[Jev Decisions Across Evaluation, Gateway, and Tracing](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/eval-monitor/scorers/llm-judge/custom-judges/typesafe/)**: Use TypeSafe models in built-in scorers and custom judges with typed Boolean or categorical feedback. (#26100, @B-Step62)
- **[Fine-Grained Permissions for Shared Resources](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/security/role-based-access-control/#sub-resource-tiers)**: Control access to contained resource types, including runs, traces, and versions, with wildcard grants and explicit DENY. (#26157, @rrrkharse)
- **[Faster Analytics for Large Trace Datasets](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/backend-store/#trace-analytics-daily-rollups)**: Reduce SQL analytics query overhead with opt-in daily summaries and raw-query fallback. (#25991, @HumairAK)
- **[Clearer Evaluation Results](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/datasets/)**: Associate aggregate logged-model evaluation metrics with the managed dataset that produced them. (#25927, @joshuawong-db)
- **[Assistant Improvements for Shared Servers](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/genai/getting-started/try-assistant/)**: Keep saved conversations scoped to the signed-in user and reset the active session when accounts change. (#26009, @kriscon-db)

**Database upgrade:** SQL-backed servers require a coordinated schema upgrade with all writers stopped and a restorable backup, even when daily rollups remain disabled. Run `mlflow db upgrade <database-url>` before restarting all replicas on the new MLflow version. Mixed-version rolling upgrades are not supported. Follow the [database upgrade instructions](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/self-hosting/architecture/backend-store/#upgrading-a-database-with-trace-analytics-data).

Agent Skills 0.6.12 is mostly about skills saying the right thing. It fixes a spec workflow that ran past its own approval gate, removes a command that does not exist and a code sample that does not parse, and slims performance-optimization the same way 0.6.11 slimmed security-and-hardening.

## Skill fixes

- **spec-driven-development stops after the spec** (#629, @nucliweb, fixes #622). On hosts that load only the skill, some models ran Specify, Plan, Tasks and Implement in one turn, because the explicit "confirm before proceeding" step lived only in the `/spec` command. The skill now ends the turn after saving the spec and waits for approval, the same fix #497 made for interview-me.
- **No more invented rollback command** (#628, @jsynowiec). The shipping-and-launch checklist told you to run `npx prisma migrate rollback`, which Prisma does not have. It now asks for your project's verified rollback command or runbook, whatever migration tool you use.
- **The idempotency example parses** (#627, @jsynowiec). A bare `throw;` in api-and-interface-design is a syntax error in JavaScript; it now rethrows the caught error.
- **performance-optimization is slimmer** (#580, @Syamsuddin, with fixes from @nucliweb's review). Step 3's code patterns moved into a skill-local `references/optimization-patterns.md`, taking SKILL.md from 496 to 267 lines. The condensed summary keeps the guidance that matters without opening the reference: when an index will not help and what to do instead (partial, trigram or expression indexes), that a bad `rows=` estimate means `ANALYZE` rather than a new index, and stating a cache's staleness window.
- **code-review-and-quality answers its own regression question** (#618, @CybotTM): invert one condition the change adds, run the suite, and report a mutation that stays green as a missing test.
- The ADR template's Status line now starts at Proposed, matching the lifecycle below it (#615, @mavericksea-ai).

## Host guides (withdrawn on main)

This release shipped setup guides for Oh My Pi (#617) and Dojo Workspace (#616). Both were withdrawn on main in #641: they were merged ahead of community host guides that had waited longer, and no maintainer had run either host. CONTRIBUTING now has a written bar for host guides. Oh My Pi is listed as one line in `docs/other-hosts.md`.

## Tooling

- **Anchors in reference links are checked** (#626, @nucliweb, fixes #625). Renaming a heading in a reference file used to break every `#anchor` link to it while CI stayed green. The validator now resolves anchors with GitHub's slug rules.
- The floor-guard reference no longer mistakes an added `++` line or a removed `--` line for a file header, and it runs from the top of the work tree so untracked files outside a subfolder are not missed (#614, @mavericksea-ai).
- Frontmatter values that start with a YAML indicator are rejected (#603, @abhisheksharma2411), and so are top-level frontmatter keys outside the spec, with the per-agent configuration guide now linked from CONTRIBUTING, the README and skill-anatomy (#608, @ayobamiseun).
- Every plugin eval grader counts the slash-command path as well as the skill (#613, @federicobartoli).

## Thanks

Thanks to everyone who contributed and reviewed this release: @nucliweb, @jsynowiec, @andrebrait, @un33k, @mavericksea-ai, @federicobartoli, @CybotTM, @ayobamiseun, @abhisheksharma2411, and @Syamsuddin.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/compare/0.6.11...0.6.12

Agent Skills 0.6.11 is a correctness and tooling release. A few fixes change what you actually get from the pack, so they come first; the rest tightens the evals, validators, and CI that keep the catalog honest.

## Fixes worth knowing about

- **The floor-guard reference now does what it promised** (#600, @mavericksea-ai, fixes #599). The reference guard in constraint-driven-development silently passed on untracked suppressions, deleted test files, and loosened maximum budgets, 7 of the 14 cases it claimed to catch. It now catches all of them, respects `.gitignore`, and has a test suite in CI. If you adapted it into your own project, pull the new version.
- **security-and-hardening is slimmer and keeps its rules** (#579, @Syamsuddin; #589, @nucliweb). Code patterns moved into a skill-local `references/hardening-patterns.md`, cutting SKILL.md from 524 to 216 lines. The condensed prose had dropped a few rules, and #589 restores them: `sameSite` as the CSRF defense, `npm audit signatures` / `pnpm audit signatures`, retention with a working deletion path, and validating every tool argument an LLM passes.
- **simplify-ignore no longer corrupts restored blocks on bash 5.2** (#501, @ayobamiseun). With `patsub_replacement` on by default, `&` and backslashes in protected code were mangled on restore. Fixed, with sdd-cache and simplify-ignore regression suites now running in CI.
- **code-review-and-quality fires on pasted diffs and pull requests** (#612, @federicobartoli), a finding from the plugin eval pilot below.

## Skills

- interview-me stops its turn once intent is confirmed instead of starting downstream work (#497, @Varun-Chinthoju).
- frontend-ui-engineering adds reference-led finish checks: references as evidence, never templates (#496, @samuelbushi).

## Evals

- **`claude plugin eval` pilot** (#596, #611, @federicobartoli): loads the whole plugin and measures whether Claude Code's own router picks a skill and what it adds to the reply. On demand only, scoped to `evals/plugin/` through the manifest.
- Graders are stricter: stale grading from a crashed run can no longer pass as current, and runs record their identity (#587, @mavericksea-ai); the ADR eval grades status and date instead of an expectation the skill never states (#598, @mavericksea-ai); negative trigger cases now name their owner, so they can't pass vacuously (#493, @Zlobin-K).

## Validators and CI

- Validators run on macOS and Windows as well as Linux (#590, @ayobamiseun).
- Links inside a skill's own `references/` files are now checked (#588, @nucliweb, fixes #585), on shared CommonMark fence parsing (#586, @ayobamiseun).
- Frontmatter must be valid YAML for both skills and commands (#594, #595), negated trigger clauses are all stripped rather than only the first (#605), and the skill-anatomy layout rules plus a 500-line SKILL.md budget are enforced (#571), all @abhisheksharma2411.
- The artifact-path guard covers every command surface, including the Gemini and root TOML copies (#607, @ayobamiseun).
- Manifest versions are validated against the root `plugin.json` rather than the latest git tag (#498, @aoright).

## Thanks

Thanks to everyone who contributed and reviewed this release: @nucliweb, @federicobartoli, @mavericksea-ai, @ayobamiseun, @abhisheksharma2411, @Syamsuddin, @aoright, @Zlobin-K, @samuelbushi, and @Varun-Chinthoju.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/compare/0.6.10...0.6.11

Agent Skills 0.6.10 is a reliability and platform release. It changes one default behavior worth reading first, fixes the Windows SessionStart failures, closes a data-loss bug in the simplify-ignore hook, tightens the eval and validator tooling, and lands a wave of cross-host portability docs.

## Behavior change (read this first)

- **The plugin no longer auto-injects the `using-agent-skills` meta-skill on SessionStart** (#574, @santhiprakash, fixes #569). Claude Code and Codex already discover and activate skills from their descriptions, so the old hook was stacking a second router on top of the native one, the pattern our own `getting-started.md` warns against, and it cost roughly 3.5k tokens per session for no gain on those hosts. The standalone `hooks/session-start.sh` stays in the repo as an opt-in helper for hosts without native skill routing. If you were relying on the meta-skill being force-loaded every session, wire that script into a `SessionStart` hook yourself.

## Reliability and platform

- **Windows SessionStart failures fixed** (#488, #475). They were caused by the hook above being run through PowerShell; removing the plugin-registered hook removes the failure entirely.
- **simplify-ignore no longer loses work on Stop** (#578, @mavericksea-ai). It now expands the current file contents instead of blindly restoring the backup, with a `.recovered` fallback for wholesale rewrites.
- **SessionStart payload test fixed and wired into CI** (#510, @santhiprakash). It now asserts the correct `hookSpecificOutput` envelope, replacing an assertion that was stale on main, and runs on every PR.

## Evals and validators

- **skill-lint handles every CommonMark fence form** (#568, @ayobamiseun, fixes #437). A real line-by-line scanner replaces the single regex, so tilde fences, indented fences, and longer closers are all recognized; its test is now wired into CI.
- **The eval grader is stricter** (#576, @mavericksea-ai). Each grader result is bound to a declared expectation by id, the canonical expectation text overrides the grader's paraphrase, and pass_rate is recomputed rather than trusted. Paired with rejecting null grader expectations without crashing (#563, @RogueTex).
- **Reference-link check exempts fenced examples** (#517, @abhisheksharma2411) so an example link inside a code block is no longer treated as a link to resolve, while a real broken link outside a fence still fails.
- **Reference-link assertion is portable on Windows** (#573, @dajiaohuang).
- **Routing description gaps closed and the rank-1 floor raised to 95** (#434, @ayobamiseun).

## Docs and portability

- **Don't stack a second router on native skill hosts** (#557, @kaluli123123), the guidance the behavior change above now matches.
- **Authoring rule against model-specific workarounds** (#545, @ayobamiseun, from #534): write the procedure, not the workaround around one model's failure.
- Cross-host portability and clarity: map the shared core to native adapters (#560), define restartable task boundaries (#559), clarify external artifact ownership (#554), setup for existing projects (#553), the stable browser skill name (#552), and link runnable workflow tutorials (#556), all @kaluli123123. README skill count corrected to 25 (#570, @abhisheksharma2411).
- **Context Budget Management** added to context-engineering (#447, @HMAKT99), plus SLOs and error budgets and runbook guidance across observability and shipping (#415, #422, @HMAKT99).
- Incomplete-plan guard mirrored across tools (#531, @ayobamiseun, from #518).

## Thanks

Thanks to everyone who contributed and reviewed this release: @santhiprakash, @mavericksea-ai, @ayobamiseun, @kaluli123123, @abhisheksharma2411, @HMAKT99, @dajiaohuang, @RogueTex, @nucliweb, and @federicobartoli.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/compare/0.6.9...0.6.10

SkillEvaluator v0.4.0 simplifies running evaluations and strengthens reporting, security checks, and large-catalog analysis.

## Highlights

- Run tiers directly with `skillevaluator tier1 PATH`, `tier2 PATH`, or `tier3 PATH`, with clearer provider setup, gateway model defaults, and evaluation progress.
- Scan larger Tier 2 collections with explicit entry and comparison budgets, faster vector comparisons, and actionable service-failure diagnostics.
- Improve Tier 3 script-invocation evidence, protected-path write detection, token masking, and incomplete-run feedback.
- Harden CLI rendering and secret redaction, run the Docker image as an unprivileged user, and pin the HTML report's Chart.js dependency with integrity verification.

## Upgrade notes

- `validate PATH` now runs all three tiers for skills by default. Use `--tiers 1` for keyless static CI; `--tiers`, `--no-tier3`, and `--no-autopilot` provide explicit scope controls.
- When `--agents` is omitted, Tier 3 selects a provider-native agent. Extra agent runtime preflight is opt-in through `--agent-runtime-preflight`.
- The NVIDIA Build defaults are now `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b` for chat and `nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b` for embeddings. Rebuild existing catalogs and caches when switching embedding models.

See the [v0.4.0 changelog](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md#040---2026-09-30) for the full release notes.
